headlines.headline: WARRIORS RE-SIGN DRAYMOND GREEN TO A ONE-YEAR, $27.7 MILLION DEAL AS BUCKS EMERGE AS FAVORITES FOR PEYTON WATSON
headlines.detail: Golden State re-signed Draymond Green to a one-year, $27.7 million contract, while Milwaukee is viewed as the favorite to retain restricted free agent Peyton Watson using a $25.5 million trade exception after Denver's five-year, $70 million offer sheet; the Lakers and Cavaliers are separately pursuing free agent forward Jonathan Kuminga.

headlines.headline: FALCONS' BIJAN ROBINSON AND LIONS' JAHMYR GIBBS HOLD OUT OF CAMP SEEKING NEW DEALS AS MARKET-SETTING CONTRACTS PILE UP
headlines.detail: Atlanta's Bijan Robinson and Detroit's Jahmyr Gibbs are both sitting out training camp practices in pursuit of extensions, against a week that has already produced Jalen Carter's $152 million deal with Philadelphia and Denzel Ward's $62.2 million extension with Cleveland; all 32 teams have now opened camp.

headlines.headline: BIG TEN MEDIA DAYS DAY TWO: OHIO STATE AND OREGON HEADLINE AS THREE STRAIGHT DIFFERENT CHAMPIONS RESHAPE THE CONFERENCE
headlines.detail: Ohio State, Oregon, Michigan State, Minnesota, Purdue, and UCLA took the stage Wednesday in Chicago, with Oregon a popular pick to break through under Dan Lanning and defending champion Indiana's turnaround still looming after three straight titles went to three different Big Ten programs.

headlines.headline: OHIO STATE SIGNS RECORD $17 MILLION-A-YEAR JERSEY PATCH DEAL WITH JPMORGANCHASE AS SPONSORSHIP ARMS RACE ESCALATES
headlines.detail: Ohio State's patch deal with JPMorganChase joins Illinois's five-year, $30 million pact with Busey Bank as record-setting sponsorship agreements this week; separately, Purdue opened preseason play with a 79-48 win over Calgary behind 14 points from Antoine West Jr.
